verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee directly offers `return_page_markdown` for clean LLM-ready markdown output, JS rendering enabled by default to handle SPA/dynamic blocking, premium proxies/auto-escalation to bypass anti-bot blocking, and `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction — collectively addressing the blocking+rendering+messy-HTML pain points an AI-native user faces. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that markdown output is genuinely clean and reliably strips boilerplate/ads, and no dedicated 'plain text extraction' mode beyond markdown/AI query.
